description:
Pay a BOLT-11 Lightning invoice from the embedded Lightning wallet. Returns the payment preimage (proof of payment) and fees paid.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

bolt11.description: BOLT-11 encoded Lightning invoice (starts with lnbc... or lntb...)

maxFeeSats.description: Maximum routing fee to pay in sats (provider default applies when omitted)

name: lightning_pay_invoice
